summary: This script loads product data from a JSON file into a table, then queries it to show the top 5 product categories ranked by how many items are in stock, including a count of products per category.

explanations.2: unnest() flattens nested arrays in the JSON data so each product becomes its own row; recursive := true means it keeps flattening nested structures at any depth.
explanations.3: read_json_auto() loads the JSON file and automatically figures out the column names and types based on what it finds.
explanations.5: count(*) counts rows (products) and sum(stock) adds up the stock values to get a total inventory amount per category.
